title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Cockroach Gut Microbiota
author: Kara Tinker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jz5cp86

steps.title: Thaw samples and lysozyme
steps.instruction: Remove the cockroach gut samples (stored in 100 µL RNALater at –80 °C) and the lysozyme solution (stored at –20 °C) and place both on ice to thaw.

steps.title: Aliquot sample into tube
steps.instruction: Pipette approximately 50 µL of the thawed RNALater‑preserved sample into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Wash pellet with Balanced Salt Solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Balanced Salt Solution (2.5 g K₂HPO₄, 1 g KH₂PO₄, 1.6 g KCl, 1.4 g NaCl, 10 mL 1 M NaHCO₃ per L, pH 7.2) to the tube, spin 10 min at 5,000 × g, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in TE and lysozyme incubation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 1× TE (10 nM Tris, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8) and vortex to fully resuspend the pellet; then add 10 µL lysozyme solution, mix, and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add glass beads and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 25 mg glass beads to a new 1.5 mL tube, let the mixture stand briefly for beads to settle, then transfer the supernatant to another fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: To the supernatant, add 100 µL BTL Buffer and 20 µL Proteinase K solution, vortex thoroughly, then incubate at 55 °C while shaking at 600 rpm for 60 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the digestion mixture at 10,000 × g for 2 min to pellet undigested material; keep the tube on ice, then carefully transfer the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Preheat equipment and Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Preheat the Thermomixer to 65 °C and place the Elution Buffer in a hybridization oven preheated to 65 °C.

steps.title: Add BDL buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 220 µL BDL Buffer to the supernatant, vortex to mix, then incubate at 65 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add ethanol and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 220 µL ethanol, vortex at maximum speed for 20 s; if any precipitate is visible, break it by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Bind DNA to HiBind column
steps.instruction: Insert a HiBind DNA Mini Column into a 2 mL collection tube, transfer the entire sample (including any precipitate) onto the column, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash column with HB buffer
steps.instruction: Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL HB Buffer, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash column with DNA Wash Buffer twice
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL DNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min; repeat the addition of another 700 µL DNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge again for 1 min at 10,000 × g.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty HiBind DNA Mini Column at maximum speed for 2 min to remove residual wash solution.

steps.title: Elute DNA with preheated buffer
steps.instruction: Insert the dried column into a new nuclease‑free 1.5 mL tube, add 50 µL preheated Elution Buffer to the center of the matrix, incubate 5 min at 65 °C, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Measure DNA and store
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer and store the eluted DNA at –20 °C.
